verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Deploy to isolated sandboxes monday manages... your syncs and tools run on our infra, not yours' (monday-docs-5), suggesting some sandboxed execution environment, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated test/staging workspace separate from production data for AI-native testing. Missing for 10: explicit test/staging environment with non-production data, developer-facing sandbox account/API mode, and independent confirmation that agent testing doesn't touch live boards.
